{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "4e7e2daa30c8e9295f4576d64a68cd37bd0126e46a0b695fdbd83e2a984fea31",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {"id":"D001","name":"LocalDef001","meaning":"There exist vectors qt and qx that are respectively the derivatives of τ ↦ q(x,τ) at t and ξ ↦ q(ξ,t) at x, and qt + A qx = 0.","effect_on_target":"Defines pointwise satisfaction of the vector transport system, including existence of both partial derivatives.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D002","name":"LocalDef002","meaning":"For a function into a real normed vector space, there exist time and space derivatives qt and qx at the specified point satisfying qt + speed • qx = 0.","effect_on_target":"Specialized to real-valued basis coordinates, defines each scalar transport equation with existence of its partial derivatives.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D003","name":"LocalDef003","meaning":"There exist a real eigenvalue for each index and an indexed real basis such that A applied to each basis vector equals its assigned eigenvalue times that vector.","effect_on_target":"The hypothesis is existence of a complete real eigenbasis, equivalently diagonalizability over the reals; distinct eigenvalues are unnecessary.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D004","name":"LocalDef004","meaning":"Real scalar multiplication on a space of real-valued functions is jointly continuous.","effect_on_target":"Supplies continuity of scalar multiplication needed for the vector-valued derivative predicate; adds no hypothesis on q.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D005","name":"LocalDef005","meaning":"Scalar multiplication in any real normed vector space is jointly continuous.","effect_on_target":"Supplies derivative infrastructure for the scalar transport predicate without imposing a separate assumption.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D006","name":"Algebra.id","meaning":"A commutative semiring is an algebra over itself with identity algebra map and multiplication as scalar multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Makes real scalar action on real coordinates ordinary multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D007","name":"Algebra.toSMul","meaning":"Extracts the scalar multiplication operation of an algebra.","effect_on_target":"Selects real multiplication for scalar actions used in vector scaling.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D008","name":"And","meaning":"Logical conjunction.","effect_on_target":"Requires all three principal conclusions, both derivative conditions and each equation in the local predicates, and both solution formulas.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D009","name":"CommSemiring.toSemiring","meaning":"Forgets commutativity while retaining the semiring operations and laws.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the ordinary real semiring structure for scalar actions without changing the domain.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D010","name":"DFinsupp.instEquivLikeLinearEquiv","meaning":"Provides the function-and-inverse interface for a linear equivalence.","effect_on_target":"Allows the basis coordinate equivalence to be evaluated on q(x,t).","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D011","name":"DFunLike.coe","meaning":"Extracts the function underlying a function-like object.","effect_on_target":"Interprets applications of bases and coordinate equivalences as their underlying functions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D012","name":"DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField","meaning":"A densely normed field supplies a nontrivially normed field structure with the same field and norm.","effect_on_target":"Provides the real scalar-field structure required for differentiability.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D013","name":"Differentiable","meaning":"The function is differentiable at every point of its domain.","effect_on_target":"Requires joint real differentiability of (x,t) ↦ q(x,t) everywhere on R² for the characteristic and reconstruction conclusions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D014","name":"DivisionSemiring.toSemiring","meaning":"Extracts the underlying semiring of a division semiring.","effect_on_target":"Preserves ordinary real arithmetic in the differentiability module structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D015","name":"Eq","meaning":"Equality of two objects of the same type.","effect_on_target":"All equations are exact equalities; vector equalities are equalities of functions on the finite index set.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D016","name":"EquivLike.toFunLike","meaning":"Regards an equivalence-like object as a function-like object using its forward function.","effect_on_target":"Coordinate expressions use the forward map b.equivFun from vectors to basis coefficients.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D017","name":"Exists","meaning":"Existential quantification over a specified type.","effect_on_target":"Chooses speeds and a basis before all q, x and t; local derivative witnesses may depend on the function and evaluation point.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D018","name":"Field.toSemifield","meaning":"Retains the semiring and division structure of a field.","effect_on_target":"Supplies inherited real algebraic structure without changing any operation or adding a hypothesis.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D019","name":"Fin","meaning":"Fin m is the type of natural-number indices strictly less than m.","effect_on_target":"Indexes the m vector components, basis vectors and speeds, including an empty index set when m = 0.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D020","name":"Fin.fintype","meaning":"Enumerates all indices 0 through n−1 in Fin n.","effect_on_target":"Provides finite indexing for matrix multiplication and the reconstruction sum.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D021","name":"Finite.of_fintype","meaning":"An explicitly enumerated finite type is finite.","effect_on_target":"Allows basis coordinates to be represented by an ordinary function on Fin m.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D022","name":"Finset.sum","meaning":"Sums the values of a function over a finite set in an additive commutative monoid.","effect_on_target":"Forms the finite vector sum reconstructing q from its transported basis coefficients.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D023","name":"Finset.univ","meaning":"The finite set containing every element of a finite type.","effect_on_target":"The reconstruction sum includes every i in Fin m exactly once.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D024","name":"Function.hasSMul","meaning":"Scalar multiplication on functions is inherited pointwise from their values.","effect_on_target":"Scaling an eigenvector or basis vector multiplies every component by the real scalar.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D025","name":"Function.uncurry","meaning":"Sends a curried function f to the function (a,b) ↦ f(a)(b).","effect_on_target":"The differentiability assumption concerns q jointly in the ordered variables (x,t).","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D026","name":"HMul.hMul","meaning":"Extracts the multiplication operation from its instance.","effect_on_target":"The expression speeds(i) t uses real multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D027","name":"HSMul.hSMul","meaning":"Extracts the scalar-action operation from its instance.","effect_on_target":"Expresses real scalar multiplication of vectors and of scalar derivatives.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D028","name":"HSub.hSub","meaning":"Extracts the subtraction operation from its instance.","effect_on_target":"The initial spatial argument is exactly x − speeds(i)t.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D029","name":"Iff","meaning":"Logical equivalence, requiring both implications.","effect_on_target":"Pointwise satisfaction of the vector system is equivalent in both directions to satisfaction of all coordinate equations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D030","name":"LinearEquiv","meaning":"An invertible semilinear map; with identity scalar homomorphisms, an invertible linear map.","effect_on_target":"The basis coordinate transformation is an invertible real-linear map on R^m.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D031","name":"Matrix","meaning":"A matrix is a function from row indices and column indices to entries.","effect_on_target":"A is an arbitrary fixed m by m real matrix subject to the eigenbasis hypothesis.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D032","name":"Matrix.mulVec","meaning":"The i-th component of Mv is the dot product of row i of M with v, namely the sum of M(i,j)v(j) over j.","effect_on_target":"A acts on column vectors by ordinary left matrix multiplication in both the eigenvector equation and the PDE.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D033","name":"Module.Basis","meaning":"An indexed algebraic basis of a module, giving unique finite linear expansions.","effect_on_target":"b is a spanning, linearly independent real basis of R^m, not merely a family of eigenvectors.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D034","name":"Module.Basis.equivFun","meaning":"Composes the basis representation map with the identification of finitely supported coefficients and all coefficient functions on a finite index set.","effect_on_target":"b.equivFun(v)(i) is the coefficient of b(i) in v, rather than its i-th standard component or an inner product.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D035","name":"Module.Basis.instFunLike","meaning":"The basis vector b(i) is obtained by applying the inverse representation map to the coefficient function supported at i with value one.","effect_on_target":"Identifies the vectors in the eigenvector relations and reconstruction formula as the actual vectors of b.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D036","name":"Nat","meaning":"The natural numbers, including zero.","effect_on_target":"The proposition ranges over every finite dimension m ≥ 0.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D037","name":"Ne","meaning":"Negation of equality.","effect_on_target":"Explicitly requires b(i) to be a nonzero vector for every index.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D038","name":"NonAssocSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring","meaning":"Extracts semiring operations without requiring a multiplicative identity or associativity.","effect_on_target":"Preserves real addition and multiplication in an inherited algebraic instance.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D039","name":"NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing","meaning":"Forgets the associativity requirement while preserving the commutative ring operations without a specified unit.","effect_on_target":"Provides an inherited real structure used in matrix multiplication; no nonstandard arithmetic is introduced.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D040","name":"NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing","meaning":"Forgets multiplicative commutativity from the supplied ring structure.","effect_on_target":"Retains the ordinary real operations used in A.mulVec.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D041","name":"NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring","meaning":"Retains addition, zero, multiplication and distributivity from the supplied ring.","effect_on_target":"Supplies exactly the algebraic operations needed for matrix-vector products.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D042","name":"NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Extracts the additive commutative monoid.","effect_on_target":"Supplies ordinary real addition and zero for coefficient functions and vector structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D043","name":"NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing","meaning":"Forgets norm data while retaining the commutative ring operations without a specified unit.","effect_on_target":"Connects the real normed structure to the arithmetic used in matrix multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D044","name":"NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing","meaning":"Forgets multiplicative commutativity from a nonunital seminormed commutative ring.","effect_on_target":"Retains the real seminorm and arithmetic used to build the scalar module.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D045","name":"NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup","meaning":"Extracts the seminorm, additive commutative group and induced pseudometric.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the usual real additive normed structure for real scalar modules.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D046","name":"NonUnitalSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring","meaning":"Forgets the multiplicative associativity requirement from a nonunital semiring.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the real operations in the codomain module instance for differentiability.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D047","name":"NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField","meaning":"Extracts the underlying normed field.","effect_on_target":"Retains the ordinary real field and norm in the differentiability structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D048","name":"NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing","meaning":"Retains the normed commutative ring operations and metric while forgetting the specified unit.","effect_on_target":"Provides the inherited real structure underlying matrix-vector multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D049","name":"NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing","meaning":"Regards a normed commutative ring as a seminormed commutative ring with the same operations and distance.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the standard real norm and topology used by the module instances.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D050","name":"NormedField.toField","meaning":"Extracts the underlying field.","effect_on_target":"Supplies ordinary real field operations for inherited module structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D051","name":"NormedField.toNormedSpace","meaning":"A normed field is a normed vector space over itself, with multiplication as scalar action.","effect_on_target":"Real-valued coordinates are differentiated and scaled in the usual real normed vector space.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D052","name":"NormedSpace.toModule","meaning":"Extracts the module structure of a normed space.","effect_on_target":"Uses the underlying ordinary real-linear structure for bases and differentiability.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D053","name":"OfNat.ofNat","meaning":"Interprets a natural-number literal using the specified instance.","effect_on_target":"The displayed zero literals denote the real time zero or the zero vector according to their types.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D054","name":"Pi.Function.module","meaning":"The module structure on functions is defined pointwise from the value module.","effect_on_target":"R^m has its usual componentwise real vector-space structure.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D055","name":"Pi.addCommGroup","meaning":"Functions into additive commutative groups form an additive commutative group pointwise.","effect_on_target":"The codomain of q has componentwise addition, negation and subtraction.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D056","name":"Pi.addCommMonoid","meaning":"Functions into additive commutative monoids form such a monoid pointwise.","effect_on_target":"Vector sums and the reconstruction sum are componentwise.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D057","name":"Pi.instZero","meaning":"The zero function takes the value zero at every index.","effect_on_target":"Nonzero eigenvectors are compared against the all-zero vector.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D058","name":"Pi.topologicalSpace","meaning":"The function space carries the product topology generated by coordinate evaluations.","effect_on_target":"For Fin m this is the ordinary finite-dimensional topology on R^m used for differentiability.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D059","name":"Prod","meaning":"The Cartesian product type of ordered pairs.","effect_on_target":"The joint domain of q is R × R with coordinates ordered as space then time.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D060","name":"Prod.instAddCommGroup","meaning":"A product of additive commutative groups has componentwise group operations.","effect_on_target":"The joint differentiation domain has the standard additive structure on R².","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D061","name":"Prod.instModule","meaning":"A product of modules has componentwise scalar multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Joint differentiability uses the standard real vector-space structure on R².","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D062","name":"PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace","meaning":"Extracts the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric space.","effect_on_target":"Passes the usual real metric structure to the topology used in differentiation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D063","name":"Real","meaning":"The real-number type.","effect_on_target":"All matrix entries, speeds, spatial and temporal variables, and vector components are real.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D064","name":"Real.denselyNormedField","meaning":"The real normed field has densely available positive norm sizes.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the nontrivial normed scalar field required for real differentiation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D065","name":"Real.instAddCommGroup","meaning":"The usual additive commutative group of real numbers.","effect_on_target":"Provides real addition and additive inverses in the domain and codomain.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D066","name":"Real.instAddCommMonoid","meaning":"The usual real additive commutative monoid.","effect_on_target":"Provides addition and zero for real modules and vector sums.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D067","name":"Real.instCommSemiring","meaning":"The usual commutative semiring structure of real numbers.","effect_on_target":"Supports real multiplication as scalar action through the identity algebra.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D068","name":"Real.instMul","meaning":"Real multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Forms the displacement speeds(i)t.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D069","name":"Real.instRing","meaning":"The usual ring structure of the reals.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the arithmetic underlying the function-space module for differentiability.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D070","name":"Real.instSub","meaning":"Real subtraction a − b is a plus the additive inverse of b.","effect_on_target":"Fixes the sign of the characteristic displacement as x − speeds(i)t.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D071","name":"Real.instZero","meaning":"The real number zero.","effect_on_target":"Specifies the initial time and scalar zero values.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D072","name":"Real.normedAddCommGroup","meaning":"The real additive group with its usual absolute-value norm and metric.","effect_on_target":"The scalar derivative equations use ordinary real analysis.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D073","name":"Real.normedCommRing","meaning":"The real commutative ring with its usual norm and metric.","effect_on_target":"Makes the norm and arithmetic in the algebraic and analytic structures compatible.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D074","name":"Real.normedField","meaning":"The usual real field equipped with its absolute-value norm.","effect_on_target":"Supplies real normed-space and differentiation structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D075","name":"Real.pseudoMetricSpace","meaning":"The real pseudometric is d(x,y) = |x − y|.","effect_on_target":"Fixes the usual topology on the spatial and temporal variables and scalar components.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D076","name":"Real.semiring","meaning":"The standard real semiring structure.","effect_on_target":"Provides the scalar algebra for real bases and linear coordinate equivalences.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D077","name":"Ring.toSemiring","meaning":"Extracts the semiring structure of a ring.","effect_on_target":"Retains ordinary real addition and multiplication in module construction.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D078","name":"RingHom.id","meaning":"The identity ring homomorphism r ↦ r.","effect_on_target":"The coordinate equivalence is real-linear with no transformation of scalars.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D079","name":"RingHomInvPair.ids","meaning":"The identity ring homomorphism is its own inverse.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the scalar compatibility required for the real-linear coordinate equivalence.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D080","name":"Semifield.toDivisionSemiring","meaning":"Extracts the division semiring structure of a semifield.","effect_on_target":"Preserves real arithmetic in the scalar-field instance chain.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D081","name":"SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing","meaning":"Retains the seminorm and commutative ring operations while forgetting the specified unit.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the real seminormed additive structure used for scalar modules.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D082","name":"Semiring.toModule","meaning":"A semiring acts on itself as a module by multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Real coefficients and coordinate functions use ordinary real scalar multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D083","name":"Semiring.toNonAssocSemiring","meaning":"Forgets the associativity requirement while preserving semiring operations and the identity.","effect_on_target":"Provides the inherited real structure for identity homomorphisms and additive structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D084","name":"Semiring.toNonUnitalSemiring","meaning":"Forgets the specified multiplicative identity while preserving semiring operations.","effect_on_target":"Preserves ordinary real arithmetic in an inherited instance chain.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D085","name":"UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace","meaning":"Extracts the topology of a uniform space.","effect_on_target":"Differentiability uses the topology induced by the usual real metric.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D086","name":"Zero.toOfNat0","meaning":"Interprets the literal 0 as the zero supplied by a zero structure.","effect_on_target":"Resolves zero as the zero vector or real initial time, as appropriate.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D087","name":"instHMul","meaning":"Uses an ordinary multiplication operation as heterogeneous multiplication with identical input and output types.","effect_on_target":"The displayed speed-time product is ordinary real multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D088","name":"instHSMul","meaning":"Uses an ordinary scalar action as heterogeneous scalar multiplication.","effect_on_target":"The displayed scaling operations are the selected ordinary real scalar actions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D089","name":"instHSub","meaning":"Uses ordinary subtraction as heterogeneous subtraction with identical types.","effect_on_target":"The characteristic foot uses ordinary real subtraction.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D090","name":"instTopologicalSpaceProd","meaning":"The Cartesian product has the product topology induced by its two projections.","effect_on_target":"Joint differentiability is on R² with its usual product topology.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D091","name":"AddCommGroup.toDivisionAddCommMonoid","meaning":"An additive commutative group supplies a subtraction commutative monoid retaining its addition, negation and subtraction.","effect_on_target":"Provides inherited additive structure in the transport predicates without altering their zero or arithmetic.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D092","name":"AddCommMagma.toAdd","meaning":"Extracts addition from a commutative additive magma.","effect_on_target":"Selects the addition appearing in the derivative-balance equations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D093","name":"AddCommMonoid.toAddCommSemigroup","meaning":"Retains associative commutative addition from an additive commutative monoid.","effect_on_target":"Supplies inherited addition for the scalar or vector transport balance.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D094","name":"AddCommSemigroup.toAddCommMagma","meaning":"Retains commutative addition from an additive commutative semigroup.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the addition used by the local differential equations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D095","name":"AddMonoid.toAddZeroClass","meaning":"Extracts addition and its zero identity from an additive monoid.","effect_on_target":"Provides the ordinary additive zero in the derivative-balance equations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D096","name":"AddZero.toZero","meaning":"Extracts zero from a structure carrying addition and zero.","effect_on_target":"The local transport equations compare their balance against the codomain zero.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D097","name":"AddZeroClass.toAddZero","meaning":"Retains addition and zero while forgetting the identity laws as explicit structure.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the zero used in the scalar transport predicate.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D098","name":"CommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing","meaning":"Retains commutative ring operations while forgetting the specified multiplicative identity.","effect_on_target":"Provides ordinary real ring operations in local predicate instance construction.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D099","name":"DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul","meaning":"Retains scalar multiplication and its preservation of addition and zero from a distributive action.","effect_on_target":"The speed action in the transport equation remains the real module action.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D100","name":"DistribSMul.toSMulZeroClass","meaning":"Extracts a scalar action that preserves zero.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the inherited scalar action used on spatial derivatives.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D101","name":"ENormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Regards an extended-normed additive commutative monoid as extended-seminormed.","effect_on_target":"An auxiliary route to additive structure for the normed codomain; does not change the transport predicate.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D102","name":"ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Extracts the additive commutative monoid from an extended-seminormed additive commutative monoid.","effect_on_target":"Provides the codomain addition and zero in the local scalar equation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D103","name":"ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddMonoid","meaning":"Forgets commutativity from the extended-seminormed additive structure.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the codomain additive operations in an auxiliary structure chain.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D104","name":"ESeminormedAddMonoid.toAddMonoid","meaning":"Extracts the additive monoid of an extended-seminormed additive monoid.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the same additive zero and addition used by the transport predicate.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D105","name":"Fintype","meaning":"A finite type structure providing an exhaustive finite enumeration.","effect_on_target":"The local matrix definitions require finite row and column indexing; Fin m supplies it automatically.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D106","name":"HAdd.hAdd","meaning":"Extracts the addition operation from its instance.","effect_on_target":"Combines the time derivative with the matrix-transformed or speed-scaled spatial derivative.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D107","name":"HasDerivAt","meaning":"The one-variable function has the specified derivative at the given point, using the neighborhood filter with the base point fixed.","effect_on_target":"Both local transport predicates require actual two-sided partial derivatives at the stated point, not default derivative values or weak derivatives.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D108","name":"Module.toDistribMulAction","meaning":"Extracts the distributive scalar action of a module.","effect_on_target":"Provides scalar multiplication of derivatives in the real normed-space transport predicate.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D109","name":"NegZeroClass.toZero","meaning":"Extracts zero from a structure whose negation preserves zero.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the same additive zero used in derivative-balance equations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D110","name":"NormedAddCommGroup","meaning":"An additive commutative group equipped with a compatible norm and metric.","effect_on_target":"Specifies the general codomain structure allowed by LocalDef002; the target specializes it to the reals.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D111","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toAddCommGroup","meaning":"Extracts the additive commutative group of a normed additive commutative group.","effect_on_target":"Supplies addition and inverses needed by the scalar derivative predicate.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D112","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toENormedAddCommMonoid","meaning":"A normed additive commutative group supplies an extended-normed additive commutative monoid using its induced extended norm.","effect_on_target":"Provides auxiliary additive and norm structure without extending the target beyond real-valued coordinates.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D113","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup","meaning":"Retains the norm, additive group and pseudometric while forgetting norm definiteness as a requirement.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the structure required for the real normed-space scalar action.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D114","name":"NormedSpace","meaning":"A module over a normed field with a scalar action satisfying the norm bound.","effect_on_target":"LocalDef002 is defined for real normed vector spaces; its occurrence in the target uses E = R.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D115","name":"Pi.instAdd","meaning":"Function addition is pointwise: (f + g)(i) = f(i) + g(i).","effect_on_target":"The vector transport balance is an equality in every component.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D116","name":"Real.commRing","meaning":"The standard commutative ring of real numbers with its usual arithmetic.","effect_on_target":"Fixes ordinary real arithmetic throughout the local PDE definitions and inherited instances.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D117","name":"Real.instAdd","meaning":"Real addition.","effect_on_target":"The scalar derivative balance uses ordinary real addition.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D118","name":"Real.instMonoid","meaning":"The multiplicative monoid of all real numbers, including zero.","effect_on_target":"Provides scalar-action structure without restricting speeds to nonzero or positive values.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D119","name":"SMulZeroClass.toSMul","meaning":"Extracts the scalar action from a scalar action preserving zero.","effect_on_target":"Selects the normed-space scalar action in LocalDef002.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D120","name":"SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace","meaning":"Extracts the pseudometric associated with a seminormed additive commutative group.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the codomain topology used in the derivative predicate.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D121","name":"SubNegZeroMonoid.toNegZeroClass","meaning":"Retains zero and negation together with the fact that negation fixes zero.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the codomain zero in the inherited additive structure.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D122","name":"SubtractionCommMonoid.toSubtractionMonoid","meaning":"Forgets additive commutativity from a subtraction commutative monoid.","effect_on_target":"Retains the same additive operations in a local predicate instance chain.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D123","name":"SubtractionMonoid.toSubNegZeroMonoid","meaning":"Retains addition, subtraction and negation and supplies negation of zero equals zero.","effect_on_target":"Supports extraction of the same zero used in the transport equation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D124","name":"instHAdd","meaning":"Uses ordinary addition as heterogeneous addition with identical types.","effect_on_target":"The displayed derivative sums are ordinary scalar or componentwise vector sums.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D125","name":"AddCommGroup.toAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Extracts the additive commutative monoid from an additive commutative group.","effect_on_target":"Preserves addition and zero for vector and scalar derivative balances.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D126","name":"AddCommGroup.toAddGroup","meaning":"Forgets commutativity while retaining the additive group.","effect_on_target":"Preserves codomain addition and inverses in the derivative infrastructure.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D127","name":"AddCommMonoid.toAddMonoid","meaning":"Forgets commutativity while retaining the additive monoid.","effect_on_target":"Preserves addition and zero used in inherited local predicate structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D128","name":"AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid","meaning":"Extracts the additive monoid with subtraction and negation from an additive group.","effect_on_target":"Preserves ordinary additive operations in the codomain structure chain.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D129","name":"ContinuousSMul","meaning":"The map taking a scalar and a vector to their scalar product is jointly continuous.","effect_on_target":"Supports the derivative predicate and is supplied by D004 or D005, rather than imposed on q.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D130","name":"DistribMulAction.toMulAction","meaning":"Extracts the multiplicative action from a distributive multiplicative action.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the scalar action used in the local scalar transport equation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D131","name":"Monoid.toSemigroup","meaning":"Retains associative multiplication from a monoid.","effect_on_target":"Provides the scalar semigroup for inherited real scalar actions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D132","name":"MonoidWithZero.toMonoid","meaning":"Retains the multiplicative monoid from a monoid with zero.","effect_on_target":"Keeps the ordinary multiplication of all reals as the scalar action structure.","status":"understood"},

  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "For every natural number m, including zero, let I = {0,…,m−1} and V = R^I.",
      "For every fixed real matrix A indexed by I × I, assume A admits a real eigenbasis.",
      "There exist a function c : I → R, represented by speeds, and a real basis b = (b_i) indexed by I for V. These witnesses are chosen for A before any function q or point (x,t); the existential choice of b is inside that of c.",
      "For the pointwise equivalence, q : R → R → V and x,t ∈ R are universally quantified with no regularity assumption.",
      "For the solution formulas, q : R → R → V is universally quantified subject to joint differentiability and satisfaction of the vector system everywhere; i ∈ I and x,t ∈ R in the resulting formulas are universally quantified.",
      "The derivative witnesses in each local equation are existentially quantified at that function and point: time derivative qt first, then space derivative qx. For the scalar coordinate equations these witnesses may also depend on i."
    ],
    "hypotheses": [
      "There exist real numbers λ_i and a real basis e = (e_i) of V such that A e_i = λ_i e_i for every i ∈ I.",
      "Only for the characteristic and reconstruction conclusions: the map Q : R² → V defined by Q(x,t) = q(x,t) is real differentiable at every point.",
      "Only for those same conclusions: for every x,t ∈ R, both partial derivatives q_t(x,t) and q_x(x,t) exist and satisfy q_t(x,t) + A q_x(x,t) = 0."
    ],
    "conclusions": [
      "There exist c : I → R and a basis b of V such that all the following assertions hold simultaneously.",
      "For every i ∈ I, b_i ≠ 0 and A b_i = c_i b_i.",
      "Define w_i(x,t) as the coefficient of b_i in q(x,t). For every q and every x,t ∈ R, the existence of q_t(x,t), q_x(x,t) with q_t(x,t) + A q_x(x,t) = 0 is equivalent to the following condition: for every i ∈ I, both (w_i)_t(x,t) and (w_i)_x(x,t) exist and (w_i)_t(x,t) + c_i (w_i)_x(x,t) = 0.",
      "For every jointly differentiable q satisfying the vector system everywhere, for all i ∈ I and x,t ∈ R, w_i(x,t) = w_i(x − c_i t,0).",
      "For the same q, for all x,t ∈ R, q(x,t) = Σ_{i∈I} w_i(x − c_i t,0) b_i."
    ],
    "mathematical_definitions": [
      "V = R^I is the real vector space of functions on I, with componentwise addition and scalar multiplication and the finite product topology.",
      "For v ∈ V, (Av)_j = Σ_{k∈I} A(j,k)v_k.",
      "A real basis b gives the coordinate isomorphism C_b : V → R^I characterized by v = Σ_{i∈I} C_b(v)_i b_i; b.equivFun is this forward coordinate map.",
      "For each q, w_i(x,t) = C_b(q(x,t))_i. These are basis coefficients and need not equal the standard components q(x,t)(i).",
      "The partial derivative q_t(x,t) differentiates τ ↦ q(x,τ) at τ = t; q_x(x,t) differentiates ξ ↦ q(ξ,t) at ξ = x. The same convention applies to each w_i.",
      "The derivative predicates require actual derivatives at the point in the full real domain. Joint differentiability means differentiability of Q on R² at every point and does not require continuity of its derivative.",
      "The real constant c_i is both the eigenvalue associated with b_i and the transport speed of w_i. The real constant 0 in q(x − c_i t,0) is the reference time."
    ],
    "proposition_plain_english": "Every finite square real matrix possessing a complete real eigenbasis admits a single choice of real speeds c_i and a real basis b_i of nonzero eigenvectors with A b_i = c_i b_i such that the vector transport equation decouples exactly in that basis. Specifically, for every function q of real space and real time and at every point, existence of both vector partial derivatives together with q_t + A q_x = 0 is equivalent to existence of both partial derivatives of every basis coefficient w_i together with (w_i)_t + c_i (w_i)_x = 0. Moreover, every everywhere jointly differentiable q satisfying the vector equation everywhere has w_i(x,t) = w_i(x − c_i t,0) for every i,x,t, and therefore q(x,t) is the sum over all i of w_i(x − c_i t,0)b_i. The same speeds and basis work for all such functions and all points."
